plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: A complete process system for how work starts, gets designed, gets verified, and lands: audits scoped from the request, brainstorming that resolves design and route choices (direct / plan / goal handoff), implementation discipline (TDD, systematic debugging, evidence-gated readiness), adversarial review at readiness, and landing that files the PR and tends CI to green. Backed by five read-only review agents. Core process skills derived from obra/superpowers (MIT): no hooks, no dispatcher; skills fire on relevance. Adds epic-orchestration for multi-ticket epics whose lanes other sessions implement and the operator dispatches by hand.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-report (report to a polished dark HTML page, from a doc or from session findings), arch-map (derived architecture maps), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), get-pr-comments (triages a PR's feedback into a prioritized action list, read-only), adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and rules onto a machine, additively), and me-human (dogfood a system from a human user's perspective). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.
